name: hc-feat-report-summary
prompt: Feature: add a one-line summary at the top of the monthly, weekly and daily report emails, in both the HTML and the plain-text versions, so a reader sees at a glance how the period went. Copy (the period is shown in the user's timezone): - monthly: "In December, 1 check had 1 downtime event." - weekly: "Last week (January 6 to January 12), 1 check had 1 downtime event." - daily: "Yesterday (January 12), 1 check had 1 downtime event." - the counts pluralise as usual ("2 checks had 3 downtime events"). - in the HTML version the two counts are bold: "In December, 1 check had 1 downtime event." - when nothing went down in the period: "In December, no checks had downtimes. Nice!" (with the same period wording for weekly and daily). Check that it reads right in real reports, for checks with and without downtime in the period.
